cover: Drone strikes kill seven, three children
Israeli strikes kill six to seven
Custody death: family to see CCTV

stories.label: Sudan's war
stories.head: Drone strikes on two villages
bullets: Three children were killed at a water pump.
Four farmers were killed; 14 people were injured.
Activists blame the army; no army comment reported.

stories.label: Palestine
stories.head: Strikes near Bureij and Deir al-Balah
bullets: Four were killed near Bureij camp, civil defence says.
Anadolu, citing medics, counted seven dead.
Israel says it targeted military operatives.

stories.label: India · Right upheld
stories.head: Terror-law charges dropped
bullets: Journalist Rejaz Sydeek has been jailed since May 2025.
He still faces BNS charges, incl. section 152.
Police had alleged Maoist links; bail hearing 3 Dec.

stories.label: Accountability Watch
stories.head: Custody death: family to see footage
bullets: Lorry driver R Balakrishnan died in a station on 14 Nov.
High Court: family may view the footage on 23 Nov.
Police say suicide; the state opposed release.
